subfields.name: ENABLE
subfields.description: Controls whether the DW_apb_i2c is enabled

subfields.name: ABORT
subfields.description: When set, the controller initiates the transfer abort

access_constraints.consequence: SYNTHETIC probe constraint: writes while an ABORT is in progress would race the hardware-managed abort sequence
access_constraints.datasheet_text: SYNTHETIC (mechanics probe, not a corpus extraction): The software cannot clear the ABORT bit once set; it is cleared automatically after the abort operation. IC_ENABLE must not be rewritten while ABORT is in progress.
